lines: Alright, that takes care of that♪
That was a hell of a lightning strike... You're a monster...
The gate attendants from the student council were knocked out in a flash, mainly by Yukikaze.
We had also joined in, but it had hardly been necessary.
Hey, going in the front door is the quickest way, no?
Yukikaze, who had enjoyed fighting the gate attendants, said proudly.
Yeah, if no one has to clean up the mess.
What do you mean by that? You didn't even do anything.
It's not like I need your help, Fuma, but how about you at least pretend to help in the fight?
I didn't see why I had to pretend to help in the fight. I had been leading Hebiko and Shikanosuke as always.
However, since I had been giving my commands by hand or eye signal, it couldn't be helped if it looked like I was just messing around.
More importantly, what are you planning to do? They saw our faces.
It's fine, it's fine. I've got a per~fect idea♪
Yukikaze smirked, grabbed the head of one of the unconscious gate attendants in her hands, and began to shoot lightning bolts.
Hmm... memory erasure. If I give them a jolt like this, they'll forget all about us, right?
The two girls were happy, but I wondered if it was just my imagination that the gate attendant's body jerked unpleasantly every time Yukikaze jolted them.
Hey, Fuma, is that really okay?
I-I have a feeling it's not.
Shikanosuke, who was more or less an electricity user, was watching over them with a pale face.
